basic_info.description: This recently renovated, stylish Northwest corner condominium at The Summit at 999 Green showcases cinematic views of the Golden Gate, Alcatraz & San Francisco Bay  bright by day and dazzling at night!  Dark oak floors & abundant natural light from two large walls of glass define the entertaining rooms. Open layout kitchen + dining + living areas combine to share floor-to-ceiling glass walls that slide open to extend the living space outdoors to a dramatic terrace spanning the width of the home. The contemporary kitchen boasts an oversized island with Italian marble, custom European cabinetry, and top-of-the-line Bosch, Miele & Sub-Zero appliances. The primary suite features a glass wall with views of Alcatraz, a marble-clad bathroom with double vanities and large, glass-enclosed shower, as well as a walk-in closet. A second bedroom also enjoys the dynamic panorama and shares the northern terrace. Radiant heat, sophisticated lighting and plentiful storage complete this home. Located at the peak of Russian Hill with sweeping views in all directions, 999 Green is a landmark mid-century hi-rise designed by modernist Bay Area architect, Joseph Eichler. Amenities include a 24-hour attended & ODADA-designed lobby, parking, storage, on-site management, and Resident's Outdoor Plaza.
